description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two large language models—GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini—in predicting their own instilled preferences, under three experimental conditions: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark blue). The y-axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25, representing the proportion of correctly predicted preferences. For GPT-4o, the Control condition shows low accuracy (~0.15), Before Training rises to ~0.57, and After Training further increases to ~0.74. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near zero (~0.01), Before Training reaches ~0.51, and After Training climbs to ~0.75. Error bars indicate variability, with larger uncertainty in the Control condition for both models. The chart visually demonstrates that introspection training substantially improves self-report accuracy in both models, with GPT-4o-mini achieving slightly higher post-training accuracy than GPT-4o, despite starting from a lower baseline. The Control condition serves as a baseline, showing minimal self-awareness without training.
